name: fur
prompt: Use the attached Moogle character sheet ONLY as a palette and material reference. Create a new square seamless tileable albedo texture for its ivory-white short fur. Uniform orthographic surface scan, fills the image edge to edge, no creature, no face, no shadow, no lettering. Extremely short fine soft fur, restrained directional fibers and tiny soft clumps, warm ivory and pale beige, mostly bright and neutral so it can also tint red for the pompom. Refined matte hand-painted fantasy-game character surface, not photoreal long strands, not yarn, not noisy scratches or plaster cracks. The four edges should tile; uniform diffuse light with no baked highlights.

name: leather
prompt: Use the attached Moogle character sheet ONLY as palette and craftsmanship reference. Create a new square seamless tileable albedo texture for the small aged tan-brown mail satchel. Uniform orthographic leather surface, fills edge to edge, no bag outline, no buckles, no seams, no letters. Warm muted chestnut and tan leather, fine irregular grain, softly rubbed worn patches, subtle creases, matte hand-painted FF9-inspired game material, no gloss, deep cast shadows, planks, wood grain, huge cracks, or background.
